title: STAR CATCH
oneLiner: Guide a friendly star through a sparkling sky, catch the gems, and dodge the storm clouds.
mechanics: Move the bright five-point star left and right along the bottom sky lane.
Catch descending gems for 100 points; three gems in a row briefly doubles the score.
Dodge storm clouds that drift downward in readable waves; collecting a shield grants one safe hit.
Every 20 seconds, enter a short recovery lull, then resume with at most three simultaneous clouds.

controls.a: Activate a held shield when available

lose: Lose a life after touching a storm cloud without a shield; three lives end the round.
scoring: Gems score 100 points, with a capped 2x bonus for three consecutive catches.
